desc: Derive feasibility predicate can(D): exists labeling t with t(1)=0, t(N)=D, t(v)<=t(u)+1 for every edge, using <=K edges with t(v)=t(u)+1; "at most K" is equivalent since extra edges can be added harmlessly.

Implement flow network for fixed D: threshold nodes (v,i), INF source/sink forcing edges, INF monotonicity edges (v,i+1)->(v,i), INF implication edges (v,i)->(u,i-1) for i>=2, capacity-1 cost edges (v,i)->(u,i); solve min cut with Dinic max-flow.
Combine into solve(): scan D from N-1 down to 0, take the maximum D with maxflow(D)<=K, print it; D=0 trivially feasible; INF=10**9 > K.
Read stdin correctly (multigraph, duplicate edges kept distinct), write only the integer answer to stdout.
Test on samples 1,2,3 (expect 1,2,0) plus edge cases: parallel edges, K=M, and infeasible D.
Fallback if min-cut misbehaves: switch to alternate exact method.
